label: GO, late episode: sticking with a2 after a rare, unrewarded a2 trial
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass), only when the agent is about to choose a2 (it is also active only where model_act == a2 and the choice logit is strongly negative, below -8.9), and almost only after an unrewarded previous trial (98.7% of mass has prev_reward 0). The previous trial was nearly always a2 that went rarely to S1 (prev_common 0 holds 84% of mass; prev_common is unknown on the window first trial). So it is the model-based repeat of a2 after a rare, unrewarded transition. It also has a strong episode-time dependence: no activity before trial ~70, and the rate climbs through trials 80-99. Value is low (bottom third). It also fires on 73% of GO steps that carry a fixation-error penalty (in_rew -1), which is a small share of mass. It does not fire at D1 or D2, on a1 choices, or after rewarded trials. The upcoming action is the agent own choice, so no unobservable future variable is used. Dev: P 0.75, R 0.81, F1 0.78, mass recall 0.96. Requiring prev_common == 0 gives P 0.86 but R 0.67. Magnitude was not analysed beyond the quartile coverage: the top quartiles are fully covered and the misses are low-activation.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (GO: a2 S1 u, a1 S1 u, ?) and trial before (GO: a2 S1 u, a2 S2 r, ?); timing cues that raise it most: phase=GO & ep_dec=9, phase=GO & ep_dec=8, phase=GO & ep_dec=7.
